blot.definition:
n. an act that brings discredit to the person who does it
v. dry (ink) with blotting paper
blot.translation:
n. 污点, 墨水渍
vt. 乱涂, 使模糊, 吸干
vi. 弄上墨渍, 吸墨水

blot on one's escutcheon.translation: [法] 污名, 名誉上的瑕疵

blot on title.translation: [法] 所有权的缺陷, 所有权的瑕疵

blot sth out.translation: 抹去, 涂掉, 涂去, 抹掉, 把...弄模糊, 遮暗, 消灭, 杀掉

blotch.translation:
n. 大斑点, 污斑, 疹块
[医] 污点, 斑点

blotched.definition: s. marked with irregularly shaped spots or blots

blotches.definition:
n an irregularly shaped spot
v mark with spots or blotches of different color or shades of color as if stained
blotches.translation: n. （皮肤上的）红斑, 疹块( blotch的名词复数 ); 大滴 [大片]（墨水或颜色的）污渍

blotchier.translation: a. 到处有污点的；有疤的 (blotchy的变形)

blotchiest.translation: a. 到处有污点的；有疤的 (blotchy的变形)

blotching.translation:
n. 大斑点, 污斑, 疹块
[医] 污点, 斑点

blotchy.definition: s. marred by discolored spots or blotches

bloted.translation:
n. 墨水渍；污渍, 斑渍, 污斑；瑕疵；不雅观的事物；相形见绌的东西；有损整体美的东西
vt. 涂污, 玷污, 沾染, 用(墨水等)弄脏, 把…弄脏：；玷污, 污损(名誉等), 使丢脸, 使蒙受耻辱：
vi. 弄上墨渍(或污渍), (墨水)渗开, 造成污渍；染污：；变污, 被弄上污渍

bloting.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Blote
bloting.translation:
n. 墨水渍；污渍, 斑渍, 污斑；瑕疵；不雅观的事物；相形见绌的东西；有损整体美的东西
vt. 涂污, 玷污, 沾染, 用(墨水等)弄脏, 把…弄脏：；玷污, 污损(名誉等), 使丢脸, 使蒙受耻辱：
vi. 弄上墨渍(或污渍), (墨水)渗开, 造成污渍；染污：；变污, 被弄上污渍

blots.definition:
n a blemish made by dirt
n an act that brings discredit to the person who does it
v dry (ink) with blotting paper
v make a spot or mark onto
blots.translation:
n. 污渍( blot的名词复数 ); 墨水渍; 错事; 污点
v. 涂污( blot的第三人称单数 ); （用吸墨纸）吸干

blotted.translation: v. 涂污( blot的过去式和过去分词 ); （用吸墨纸）吸干

blotted out.translation: na. 涂去(文字)；遮掉(风景等)；杀掉；毁掉

blotter.definition: n. the daily written record of events (as arrests) in a police station
blotter.translation:
n. 吸墨纸, 记事簿
[经] 草帐, 原始帐, 临时记录

blotter paper.translation: [化] 吸墨纸; 吸墨水纸

blotters.definition:
n. absorbent paper used to dry ink
n. the daily written record of events (as arrests) in a police station
blotters.translation: n. 吸墨纸( blotter的复数形式 ); 临时记录簿, 记事本

blottesque.definition:
a. Characterized by blots or heavy touches; coarsely
   depicted; wanting in delineation.

blotting.definition:
v dry (ink) with blotting paper
v make a spot or mark onto

blotting paper.definition:
A kind of thick, bibulous, unsized paper, used to
   absorb superfluous ink from freshly written manuscript, and thus
   prevent blots.
blotting paper.translation:
吸墨水纸
[化] 吸墨纸; 吸墨水纸

blottings.definition:
plural of blotting
v dry (ink) with blotting paper
v make a spot or mark onto
